title: heap-use-after-free in ObjectDB::cleanup
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible: 4.4-stable [4c311cb]

### System information

Linux Manjaro - Godot 4.4-stable - Forward+ - Nvidia 4080

### Issue description

Got leaked object on exit and crash.
